subject: Public determination and Agency actualisation operation
result: The pre-#97 Wayfinder requirement is still open. Current product ground exposes Agency reading and library-level determination validation, but records that no public create or configuration command is established. Next condition: inspect current application and Action state, then either prove an existing public operation against the ten required cases or open and implement the smallest Actuation-native child that binds an existing Agent or actualises a bounded new Agency without manufacturing authority.
